title: Did You Know Octopuses Think With Their Arms?
description: You will learn how octopuses use the two-thirds of their neurons located in their arms to process sensory information independently from their central brain. Discover how this decentralized nervous system allows each arm to solve complex tasks with remarkable autonomy. Subscribe and follow us for more.
